title: Calculate TMB from filtered VCF and callable BED territory
description: Execute a digest-bound implementation that classifies ALT-matched ANN consequences in a filtered biallelic VCF, merges overlapping callable BED intervals, restricts variants to that territory, and reports nonsynonymous mutations per union megabase without universal clinical cutoffs.
intents: tumor mutational burden with panel BED
根据VCF和可调用BED计算肿瘤突变负荷
questions: What is the nonsynonymous mutation burden after ALT-specific ANN classification and normalization by the nonoverlapping callable territory of the same assay and reference assembly?
assumptions: The VCF is a somatic, upstream-filtered, ALT-specific ANN-annotated call set; BED intervals represent assay-specific callable territory rather than nominal targets; VCF and BED share reference build, sequence digest, chromosome namespace, sample, and assay identity.
preconditions: VCF records are biallelic, coordinate sorted, PASS-filtered, and ANN-annotated; callable BED records are valid zero-based half-open intervals; reference and sample identities reconcile exactly before execution.

quality_gates.description: VCF and BED reference build, sequence digest, chromosome namespace, sample manifest, assay identity, filtering provenance, annotation release, and coordinate conventions must reconcile.
Callable BED intervals must be valid and their per-contig union must be positive; overlapping or adjacent bases are counted once.
Every VCF record requires an ANN entry matching its ALT allele; each variant is counted at most once using its highest-impact declared nonsynonymous consequence.

TMB has no universal high/low cutoff; assay, indication, germline subtraction, purity, clonality, sequencing sensitivity, validation, and jurisdiction-specific evidence are required before clinical interpretation.

version_differences.description: The supported line executes deterministic ANN classification, BED union, and JSON number handling in the digest-bound project implementation.
version_differences.required_action: Record interpreter and implementation hashes and independently verify variant classification, interval union, denominator, and TMB arithmetic.

dependencies.name: python-stdlib
dependencies.purpose: Provide deterministic parsing, interval union, counting, and JSON serialization for the TMB implementation.

limitations: The validated row accepts upstream-filtered, biallelic VCF 4.5 with ALT-matched ANN and assay-specific BED 1.0 territory. It does not perform germline subtraction, purity or clonality modeling, mutational signatures, callability estimation, assay calibration, clinical cutoff validation, or treatment recommendation.

concept_sources: Independent clean-room implementation of ANN-based mutation burden with callable-territory union.
